text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Love me♡ Love you♡
It's Loves Only You!♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's chat a whole bunch together
again today, okay?♪
—What should the ideal relationship between an umamusume and her fans look like?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
For early morning workouts, I go for runs outside the academy.
Lately I've been running along the river all the way up to the hill.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: The air is so crisp and refreshing, and it's super easy to film there too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“I wanna follow your example!”... Fufu, thank you♡ In my case, it's about
15km round trip, but make sure to pick a distance that's comfortable for you♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and “MuscleDad” in the comments, you asked a question last week, right?
I made a video on “How to Lift Without Hurting Yourself,” putting it up now~♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
If you lock your elbows like this
instead of using momentum to jerk the weights up, you'll avoid getting injured.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“Still keeping up with my workouts~!”... Fufu, “Three-Day Quitter Girl”,
you're definitely not a quitter anymore! I think that's super amazing♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Also~ I wanted to talk about nutrition, which goes hand-in-hand
with training, so I made a little cooking video for you too~♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
This is actually a dish I make quite a lot on a regular basis.
It's high in protein, but balances all kinds of nutrients nicely.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Stir-frying veggies and chicken breast with sesame oil is an unbeatable combo♪
“Loves Meal Special”...? Fufu, then let's definitely do that sometime♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All right, that's all for tonight!
Love me♡ Love you♡ This was Loves Only You!♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Stream ending wipe playback dummy text.
That was a great stream... Well, then.

text_block_list.name: Three-Day Quitter Girl
text_block_list.text: “Aaah! Loves-chan praised me... I'm so happy...! She even shared recipes with us, I'm definitely keeping up my training!”

text_block_list.name: MuscleDad
text_block_list.text: “I'll pay close attention to my form just like she advised! I feel like I can really keep going with this!”

Gathered here were fans of the umamusume Loves Only You.
Members of the community run directly by her.
Interested in how umamusume and their fans form communities, I stumbled across this place by chance. Since then, I've been a “comm-mem” myself.
choice_data_list: Well, I'll be taking off for today.

text_block_list.name: Hot-Blooded Teacher
text_block_list.text:
“Oh!
Have a good one, ‘Bridge-san’!”
Interacting with and cheering on a horsegirl striving for her debut alongside faceless, nameless peers. I truly cherished this strange, gentle time.

Then one day, I saw a familiar face staying late to train.
...Well, familiar in the sense that I recognized her, not that we'd actually met.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm... not enough extension in my stride?
...Oh? Um... did you need something from me?
choice_data_list: Ah, no—I just thought... that was a great run.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hehe! Why, thank you. Say, you're a Trainer, right?
Would you mind giving me a little advice?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hehe! Why, thank you. Say, you're a Trainer, right?
Would you mind giving me a little advice?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! Keeping my upper body upright like you said
feels super natural. You pros really do know your stuff!
choice_data_list: No, really, I'm just a total rookie...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? But my lap times actually improved,
so your advice made me super happy♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Now I've got some great news to share with my commu-members on stream♪
...Oh, "commu-members" is what I call everyone in my fan community!

—I knew that. I knew that full well... but I was acting as a Trainer here.
I suppressed my inner fan and played dumb.
choice_data_list: Streaming, huh... That must be tough on top of your busy schedule.
Streaming, huh... That must be tough on top of your busy schedule.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's not tough at all!
I've been doing it for years and years now, after all.

Going with the flow of the conversation,
I decided to ask something I'd wondered about for a long time.
choice_data_list: Why do you put so much effort into streaming?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hrmm... The reason is—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Love," I suppose?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—So today, when I told someone I met during training about my streams,
they asked me, "Why do you work so hard on your streams?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"It's second nature"... Yeah, pretty much! There are way fewer days I don't stream than days I do.
Ever since I was little, the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—"Because of love!" Ahaha, exactly, that's it!
Because this place is full of the love I adore—so much warm affection.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I bring smiles to everyone, and everyone gives me their support.
I send out good vibes, and everyone gives me courage in return.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
On good days, and on bad days too.
Without putting on airs, just sharing who I truly am...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
When you keep that up, doesn't it make you feel super close?
Everyone's feelings right beside me. And my feelings right beside everyone.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Come on, showing off my 100 on a test was back in elementary school!
I definitely don't do that anymore~

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...But you know, it's precisely in a bond where we can share things like this
that I truly feel it. What "love" really is.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, see you next time♪
Love me♡ Love you♡ It was Loves Only You~♡"
choice_data_list: ...Feeling each other's support so close, huh...

text_block_list.text:
In recent years, the racing world has evolved alongside entertainment.
As a result, there are many different ways horsegirls are loved by their fans.

The traditional path: commanding adoration purely through athletic dominance.
The horsegirl demonstrates sheer power on the turf, and fans are captivated by that strength.

And the modern path: charming audiences beyond just running.
More than a few captivate massive followings with idol-like talent.

Horsegirls relate to their fans in all kinds of ways,
but for Loves Only You, it was something distinct from either of those.

I couldn't quite put it into words yet—but the bond she shared with her fans
gave me a feeling that an unprecedented, brand-new future was taking shape...
